caption: The drawing consists of a single outlined shape resembling a stylized mouse or rodent, placed centrally within a rectangular frame created by a single line. The body of the figure is elongated and oval-shaped, colored in a smooth gradient of grey shading with darker outlines emphasizing its form. At one end, the pointed head features a small circular ear, a round eye, and a short projection for the nose. The tail, starting thick and tapering to a point, curves upward and to the left, also shaded in grey. The figure appears to rest on four round-ended shapes crossed underneath the body, mimicking legs or possibly stylized bones. The background is a plain, off-white or beige unshaded surface. The composition overall is simple and centered, with no additional objects or scenery present.
title: Glass Mouse
